title: RIE Knowledge Graph Relationship Edge Contract
description: Formal contract defining a verified, typed, directed relational edge with mandatory provenance attachment.

relationship_id.description: Unique identifier of the relational edge.

source_entity.description: Identifier or title of the source entity node.

target_entity.description: Identifier or title of the target entity node.

relationship_type.description: Controlled predicate from the approved closed relationship vocabulary.

provenance_source.description: Path to the primary empirical evidence source container.

evidence_reference.description: Precise evidentiary locator (e.g. line numbers, offset, table).

sha256_hash.description: Cryptographic SHA-256 hash of the evidence container.

approval_reference.description: Directive or decision authorizing the relationship (e.g. DEC-080-KG-CORE).

metadata.description: Additional edge properties and domain annotations.
